items.title: Fewer preventable hospitalizations
items.subtitle: Full practice authority for nurse practitioners
items.alt_text: Complete three-panel Figure 3 showing changes in diabetes, chronic, acute, and overall preventable hospitalization outcomes under full practice authority for nurse practitioners. Each outcome retains its original point estimate and 90 and 95 percent confidence intervals.
items.context: All published outcomes are retained; the acute-composite estimate is not statistically significant.
items.source: The Impact of Nurse Practitioner Scope-of-Practice Laws on Preventable Hospitalizations, Figure 3, PDF p. 10.
items.treatment: Complete original three-panel figure crop; original axes, outcomes, point estimates, and 90% and 95% confidence intervals retained.

items.title: FCA sanctions rival malpractice liability
items.subtitle: Healthcare FCA sanctions and medical malpractice damages over time
items.alt_text: Healthcare False Claims Act sanctions and medical malpractice damages over time on the original logarithmic scale.
items.context: A descriptive comparison of liability, not a causal estimate; annual monetary totals are adjusted to 2018 dollars.
items.source: A Constitutional False Claims Act, Figure 1, PDF p. 21.
items.treatment: Complete original figure crop; logarithmic scale, series labels, and original units retained.

items.title: Mortality inside and outside the transplant system
items.subtitle: Estimated effects of eliminating geographic allocation boundaries
items.alt_text: Estimated effects of eliminating geographic allocation boundaries: waitlist mortality minus 2.53 deaths per 1,000 waitlisted patients per month; one-year post-transplant mortality minus 1.72 percentage points; transplant-amenable mortality plus 0.61 deaths per million residents per month. Standard errors appear in parentheses.
items.source: Adapted from Sharing Is Caring, Table 5, columns 2–3, PDF p. 44, and Table 7, column 1, PDF p. 45.
items.treatment: Selected reported estimates reformatted into a semantic table; no new estimation.

table.caption: Estimated effects of eliminating geographic allocation boundaries
table.note: Standard errors are in parentheses; all displayed estimates have p < 0.01. Outcomes use different populations, denominators, and units and should not be combined.

items.title: Broader practice authority and lower mortality
items.subtitle: Annual healthcare-amenable deaths per 100,000 residents
items.alt_text: Estimated changes in annual healthcare-amenable deaths per 100,000 residents. Nurse practitioner full practice authority: minus 12.177 for all counties and minus 15.620 for rural counties. Physician assistant remote practice authority: minus 9.927 for all counties and minus 26.431 for rural counties. Standard errors appear in parentheses.
items.source: Adapted from Supply-side Health Policy, Table 2, column 6, panels A–B, PDF p. 9.
items.treatment: Selected reported estimates reformatted into a semantic table; no new estimation.

table.caption: Estimated changes in annual healthcare-amenable deaths per 100,000 residents
table.note: Standard errors are in parentheses. The NP rural estimate has p < 0.05; the other displayed estimates have p < 0.01. The specification includes both practice-law variables and Medicaid expansion.

items.title: Competition and organ-allocation priority
items.subtitle: Allocation-minus-laboratory MELD score gaps before and after Share 35
items.alt_text: Complete Figure 8 comparing allocation-minus-laboratory MELD score gaps in single-center and multi-center areas before and after Share 35, with the original 95 percent confidence intervals.
items.context: Larger post-Share-35 gaps in multi-center areas are consistent with strategic use of exception points.
items.source: Stealing Organs?, Figure 8, PDF p. 46; journal p. 180.
items.treatment: Complete original figure crop; baseline comparison, legend, and 95% confidence intervals retained.

items.title: Licensing and liability work together
items.subtitle: Midwife attendance and C-section use across malpractice-pressure quartiles
items.alt_text: Complete two-panel Figure 5 showing midwife attendance and C-section use across malpractice-pressure quartiles, with both practice regimes, legends, axes, and original 90 percent confidence intervals.
items.context: Differences between practice regimes narrow as malpractice pressure rises.
items.source: Healthcare Licensing and Liability, Figure 5, PDF p. 48; journal p. 867.
items.treatment: Complete original two-panel figure crop; legends, axes, and 90% confidence intervals retained.

items.title: NP independence and opioid prescribing
items.subtitle: All-payer change in annual provider-level morphine milligram equivalents
items.alt_text: All-payer estimated changes in annual morphine milligram equivalents: nurse practitioners and physicians combined minus 4.688 percent; nurse practitioners plus 4.468 percent; physicians minus 6.352 percent. P-values appear in the table.
items.source: Adapted from Nurse Practitioner Scope-of-Practice Laws and Opioid Prescribing, Table 2, PDF p. 14.
items.treatment: Selected reported percentage changes and p-values reformatted into a semantic table; no new estimation.

table.caption: All-payer estimated changes in annual morphine milligram equivalents
table.note: Reported percentage changes are reproduced from the paper. The outcome is annual provider-level morphine milligram equivalents, not prescription counts.
